description: HP-09 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Theog subdivision in the Shimla district of Himachal Pradesh. Operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office, it manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport tax collection for the local highland region.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Theog, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
